tasks.title: Scaffold the export package
tasks.context: Create the new `packages/export` workspace package for `resume_kit_export` as specified by `.metis/strategies/NULL/initiatives/RIT-I-0007/initiative.md` Detailed Design step 1. The package depends inward only on `resume_kit_schemas` and `resume_kit_core`, plus local renderer dependencies `reportlab` and `python-docx`. Define `ExportFormat` with `pdf` and `docx`, `ExportOptions`, MIME helpers, and the public `render(resume: ResumeDocument, format: ExportFormat, options: ExportOptions | None = None) -> bytes` dispatcher. The render input is `resume_kit_schemas.resume.ResumeDocument` with exact fields `personalInfo`, `summary`, `workExperience`, `education`, `personalProjects`, `additional`, `sectionMeta`, and `customSections`.
acceptance_criteria: `packages/export/pyproject.toml` exists with package name `resume-kit-export`, Hatch wheel target `src/resume_kit_export`, dependencies on `resume-kit-core`, `resume-kit-schemas`, `reportlab`, and `python-docx`, and workspace sources for internal deps.
`packages/export/src/resume_kit_export/py.typed` exists.
`resume_kit_export.models.ExportFormat` accepts only `pdf` and `docx`; `ExportOptions` is typed and deterministic with no timestamp, locale, UUID, random, or filesystem defaults.
`resume_kit_export.render.render(...)` dispatches by `ExportFormat` without importing any transport package or LLM/provider dependency.
Package-local model/dispatch tests cover valid formats, invalid formats, MIME mapping, and importability of the scaffold without invoking missing renderer behavior.
tasks.implementation_notes: Follow the leaf package style in `packages/matching/pyproject.toml`. Keep `__init__.py` conservative at this stage: export `ExportFormat`, `ExportOptions`, and `render`; defer adding `render_pdf`/`render_docx` to the late public-exports task after renderer files exist. Do not add any facade or transport imports here.

tasks.title: Implement the ReportLab PDF renderer
tasks.context: Implement deterministic PDF rendering for `resume_kit_export` using ReportLab, satisfying REQ-601/NFR-604 from `.metis/strategies/NULL/initiatives/RIT-I-0007/initiative.md`. Render `ResumeDocument.personalInfo` (`name`, `title`, `email`, `phone`, `location`, `website`, `linkedin`, `github`), `summary`, `workExperience[]` (`title`, `company`, `location`, `years`, `description[]`), `education[]`, `personalProjects[]`, `additional` (`technicalSkills`, `languages`, `certificationsTraining`, `awards`), and visible `customSections`.
acceptance_criteria: `render_pdf(resume: ResumeDocument, *, options: ExportOptions | None = None) -> bytes` returns valid `%PDF` bytes using ReportLab only.
Identical input and options produce identical bytes in repeated calls; PDF metadata is fixed and contains no wall-clock timestamp, random id, locale-dependent text, or generated UUID.

Structural tests parse produced PDF text with `pdfminer` and assert the header, contact fields, summary, experience bullets, education, projects, additional sections, and custom sections are present in deterministic order.
The renderer imports no transport package, no facade package, no provider/LLM package, and no upstream `app` namespace.
tasks.implementation_notes: Use ReportLab Platypus flowables (`SimpleDocTemplate`, `Paragraph`, `Spacer`, `ListFlowable`/bullet paragraphs, fixed styles, standard fonts). Normalize optional empty fields by omitting blank fragments, not by rendering placeholders. Set deterministic document metadata explicitly and avoid ReportLab APIs that inject creation/modification timestamps unless overridden. Keep all PDF-specific helpers in `pdf.py` so DOCX work can proceed in parallel.

tasks.title: Implement the python-docx renderer
tasks.context: Implement deterministic DOCX rendering for `resume_kit_export` using `python-docx`, satisfying REQ-601/NFR-604 from `.metis/strategies/NULL/initiatives/RIT-I-0007/initiative.md`. The renderer mirrors the PDF section content for `ResumeDocument.personalInfo`, `summary`, `workExperience`, `education`, `personalProjects`, `additional`, and visible `customSections` from `packages/schemas/src/resume_kit_schemas/resume.py`.
acceptance_criteria: `render_docx(resume: ResumeDocument, *, options: ExportOptions | None = None) -> bytes` returns valid DOCX bytes loadable by `python-docx`.

Identical input and options produce identical bytes or an explicitly documented stable structural fingerprint; core document properties and ZIP entries contain no wall-clock timestamp, random id, or locale-dependent formatting.

Structural tests reopen the DOCX with `python-docx` and assert headings, contact fields, summary, bullets, education, projects, additional sections, and custom sections are present in deterministic order.
The renderer imports no transport package, no facade package, no provider/LLM package, and no upstream `app` namespace.
tasks.implementation_notes: Use the `python-docx` API directly: headings, normal paragraphs, and bullet-list paragraph styles. For byte determinism, set core properties to fixed values and normalize ZIP entry metadata if necessary before returning bytes. Keep all DOCX-specific helpers in `docx.py` so PDF work stays file-disjoint.

tasks.title: Add the export-resume facade capability
tasks.context: Add the deterministic `export-resume` facade capability over `resume_kit_export`, following the existing async capability pattern in `packages/facade/src/resume_kit_facade/capabilities.py` and request model pattern in `packages/facade/src/resume_kit_facade/models.py`. The capability must render a `ResumeDocument` to `ExportFormat`, write bytes through `resume_kit_core.storage.ArtifactStore.put(artifact_id, artifact_type, data, content_type=..., metadata=...)`, and return `resume_kit_core.response.InterfaceResponse` with `artifacts: list[ArtifactRef]`. Tests should use `resume_kit_core.testing.FakeArtifactStore`.
acceptance_criteria: `ExportResumeRequest` exists in `packages/facade/src/resume_kit_facade/models.py` with `resume: ResumeDocument`, `format: ExportFormat`, optional `options: ExportOptions`, and a deterministic caller-supplied or hash-derived `artifact_id` path that does not use random/time values.
`CapabilityOptions` carries an optional `ArtifactStore` injection point without requiring any concrete backend or provider.

`export_resume(request, options)` renders through `resume_kit_export.render.render`, calls `ArtifactStore.put(...)`, and returns `build_success(...)` with exactly one `ArtifactRef` whose `content_type` is `application/pdf` for PDF or `application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document` for DOCX.

`REGISTRY` contains `export-resume`; the capability never requires `provider`, ignores `no_llm`, and maps `ResumeKitError`/unexpected exceptions through the same helpers used by existing capabilities.
Facade tests cover PDF and DOCX, artifact metadata, bytes retrievable from `FakeArtifactStore.get`, wrong-request validation, deterministic artifact ids/bytes, and no-provider execution.
tasks.implementation_notes: Add `resume-kit-export` as a facade dependency in `packages/facade/pyproject.toml` and `[tool.uv.sources]`. Keep raw bytes out of `InterfaceResponse.data`; transports that need bytes should pass their own store via `CapabilityOptions.artifact_store` and retrieve by returned `ArtifactRef.artifact_id`. Do not edit facade `__init__.py` here; public re-exports are handled late to avoid repeated edits.

tasks.title: Add the CLI export command
tasks.context: Add a thin CLI adapter for `export-resume` in `packages/cli/src/resume_kit_cli/app.py`, using existing helpers in `packages/cli/src/resume_kit_cli/io.py` and output rendering in `packages/cli/src/resume_kit_cli/formatters.py`. The command must mirror Phase 5 transport style: build an `ExportResumeRequest`, create `CapabilityOptions` with an injected `ArtifactStore`, invoke `resume_kit_facade.capabilities`, render the canonical `InterfaceResponse`, and exit via `resume_kit_core.interface.exit_code_for`.
acceptance_criteria: `resume-tool export --resume <resume.json> --format {pdf,docx} --out <path>` writes valid PDF/DOCX bytes to the requested path and exits 0 on success.
When `--out` is omitted, the command emits a stdout-safe JSON/text/markdown response containing artifact metadata and base64-encoded bytes rather than writing binary bytes into a formatted envelope.

CLI contract tests include help text listing `export`, successful PDF and DOCX file writes, stdout-safe base64 behavior, and JSON envelope artifact metadata.
tasks.implementation_notes: Use `io.load_resume` to parse `ResumeDocument`. Add only transport parsing/file-write/base64 behavior here; no rendering logic or ReportLab/python-docx imports belong in CLI files. Use `FakeArtifactStore` or another in-memory `ArtifactStore` instance locally, pass it on `CapabilityOptions.artifact_store`, then retrieve bytes after a successful facade response. Preserve existing `--output {json,text,md}` behavior for envelopes.

tasks.title: Fix the umbrella packaging and publish workflow
tasks.context: Make the root `resume-kit` distribution real and self-contained per REQ-605/REQ-607 in `.metis/strategies/NULL/initiatives/RIT-I-0007/initiative.md`. The current root `pyproject.toml` has `[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel] packages = ['src/resume_kit']`, which points to a hollow non-existent target. Replace it with Hatch force-includes for every import package under `packages/*/src/resume_kit_*` and `integrations/*/src/resume_kit_*`, move third-party runtime dependencies into root base/extras, declare the umbrella `resume-tool` console script, and add Trusted Publishing configuration without running an upload.
acceptance_criteria: Root `pyproject.toml` force-includes all import packages: `resume_kit_schemas`, `resume_kit_core`, `resume_kit_document_parser`, `resume_kit_job_parser`, `resume_kit_ats`, `resume_kit_matching`, `resume_kit_policy`, `resume_kit_evidence`, `resume_kit_alignment`, `resume_kit_export`, `resume_kit_facade`, `resume_kit_cli`, `resume_kit_mcp`, `resume_kit_api`, and `resume_kit_job_hunter_bridge`.
The umbrella wheel metadata has no unresolved internal `Requires-Dist` entries such as `resume-kit-core`, `resume-kit-schemas`, or other `resume-kit-*` workspace packages.

Root base dependencies include engine/export third-party dependencies such as `pydantic`, `markitdown`, `pdfminer.six`, `python-docx`, and `reportlab`; optional extras include `cli` with Typer, `mcp` with MCP SDK, `api` with FastAPI/uvicorn, and `all` as the union.
Root `[project.scripts]` exposes `resume-tool = resume_kit_cli.app:app` so `pip install resume-kit[cli]` provides the command.
PyPI metadata includes classifiers, project URLs, README long description, license file references, and includes `LICENSE`/`NOTICE` in sdist/wheel.
`.github/workflows/publish.yml` uses PyPI Trusted Publishing/OIDC, builds distributions on version tags, and does not contain credentials or auto-run on ordinary pushes.
README documents `uv build`, `pip install resume-kit`, extras `[cli]`, `[mcp]`, `[api]`, `[all]`, and manual Trusted Publishing/twine fallback without claiming the package has been uploaded.
tasks.implementation_notes: Use Hatch `force-include` mappings rather than relying on a non-existent root `src/resume_kit`. Keep per-package `pyproject.toml` files for workspace development; the umbrella shipped wheel must vendor source trees and depend only on third-party packages. Do not run publishing commands. Check built wheel metadata after `uv build` to ensure internal workspace package requirements are absent.
